notes: Jumping can now move the wanderer's body instead of carrying a standing pose through the air. It is an opt-in preview: set WAR_JUMP_MOTION=1 before launch; ordinary play remains unchanged.
The real jump drives distinct push-off, tucked-apex and landing-ready silhouettes from the wanderer's actual vertical speed, and the airborne pose clears as soon as the character lands.

Still short of the mark: there is no authored landing anticipation or impact, directional lean, turn cue, camera response, or blend into walking and running. This is the first reviewable jump arc, not a finished movement set.
title: Jumping can move the wanderer
